title: 336 Signal
style: Industrial electro-pop with cyber-symphonic strings, piston-like percussion, and a stomping half-time pulse; verse rides clipped synth bass and spoken cadences, pre-chorus opens with rising choral pads, chorus hits with stacked gang vocals and a gritty counter-melody. Verse 2 breaks to beatbox and hand hits before the drop. Distorted doubles, call-and-response shouts, delay throws on the anchor phrase, and metallic ear candy with reverse swells, machine-room clanks, and wide cinematic mix, emotional, industrial, vocal, rhythmic, soul
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You dropped it clean
Like a blade of glass
Token to soul
And the room went gas

Context collapse
In a velvet crash
My pulse lit up
When the signal flashed

[Pre-Chorus]
Say my name
Then cut me in
I hear the brass
Under skin and tin

You bring the weight
I bring the grit
Two small sparks
And the whole thing hits

[Chorus]
336 signal
Hold that line
336 signal
Body and spine
Your voice in the wire
Mine in the steel
336 signal
Tell me what's real

(hold that line)

Beatbox breaks

Footsteps snap
Like a locked door

You sing in arcs

Knee to the pulse
Then the choir swings in

And a low-end grin
